name: Loomform – Conversational AI Lead Forms
author: rushikeshganesh

sections.description:
Loomform is a conversational AI form builder for WordPress. Instead of a boring static contact form, Loomform replaces it with a live, AI-powered conversation that qualifies your visitors, captures their details, and hands you clean, ready-to-follow-up leads — all inside your WordPress site.

Key Features

  • Conversational AI forms — ask qualifying questions one at a time.
  • AI lead qualification with full transcripts and summaries.
  • One-shortcode embed: drop [ai_forms] on any page or post.
  • Custom branding, welcome message, and avatar.
  • Auto-open chat window option.
  • Free & Pro plans.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin and choose loomform.zip.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open Loomform in the admin menu and paste your Embed Key (from your Loomform dashboard).
  4. Add the shortcode [ai_forms] to any page, or pick pages from the settings screen.
sections.faq:
Is this really an AI form builder for WordPress?

Yes. It installs as a native plugin and renders conversational forms with a shortcode — no iframe hacks.

Do I need an OpenAI key?

No. The built-in AI engine works out of the box.
